title: Passing Yards Visible Leak Cleanup
root_cause: V74 _metric used an unbounded .*? capture between <b> and the requested label. The match could begin at an earlier bold tag and cross multiple closing bold tags/sections before reaching the target label, leaking market/model HTML into availability cells and the Final inactive report.
patch: New V85 presentation wrapper temporarily replaces only V74 _metric with a bounded fail-closed adjacent-bold extractor. New V237 delegates every non-Passing-Yards route to frozen V236 and swaps only the Passing Yards hub to V85.
acceptance_gates: Step 1: root cause locked to V74 unbounded metric parser
Step 2: all V74 card values are adjacent bounded values <=120 chars
Step 3: availability panel/report contain no cross-section market/model dump tokens and report is compact
Step 4: 390/768/1440 browser proof has no horizontal panel overflow, public production proof passes, Monster V236/sitewide files remain byte-identical

rebase.reason: Monster/sitewide proof advanced main while cleanup PR checks were running.
